### Blau: NOD2 numbering (D-48)

Under the registered rule a cDNA description with no stated transcript is read on MANE Select NM_001370466.1. 19 Blau descriptions failed there with a reference mismatch because the paper used the older NM_022162.3 numbering (R334W is c.1000C>T there). D-48 (decided by Claude under Jimmy's delegation, 2026-11-15) adds a fallback for Blau only: after a reference mismatch the description is sent once more on NM_022162.3. All 19 then place, each agreeing with the paper's own protein change, 27 residues higher. The table above uses the fallback; the registered-rule figures are kept in `analysis/extension/registered_rule/` and shown here.

| Rule | HGVS recall, tier 1 | HGVS recall, tiers 1+2 | Overlap, tier 1 | Classification agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Registered (pipeline v1.0) | 4.5% (1/22) | 4.5% (1/22) | 61.5% (8/13) | 72.7% (8/11) |
| D-48 fallback (adopted) | 13.6% (3/22) | 13.6% (3/22) | 63.0% (17/27) | 78.9% (15/19) |

Of the 19 Blau recall misses that remain, 17 come from papers whose extraction holds only protein changes, written in the legacy numbering (R334W, E383K, R587C), 27 residues higher than ClinVar's MANE numbering (p.Arg307Trp, p.Glu356Lys, p.Arg560Cys). A protein-only description cannot be placed, and the tier-2 protein match compares MANE numbers, so these are numbering misses, not reading errors (`analysis/extension/o2/o2_recall_misses.csv`).

Recheck against the same snapshot: 45 checked, 0 now in ClinVar. OMIM was not checked (D-12). Candidate ids are positional, so the D-48 re-run renumbered the Blau ids; the earlier Blau dossiers were carried over by genomic position (002→003, 003→004, 004→005, 005→008).

**Withdrawn (D-48; rows and dossiers kept, reason in `status_note`):**

- **G-blau-008** (16:50711530:T:C): withdrawn (D-48, 2026-11-15; Claude under Jimmy's delegation): the papers write c.1538T>C (M513T) in legacy NM_022162 numbering; with no transcript stated it was read on MANE, where the reference base also matches, giving p.Leu513Pro, which no paper describes. On MANE the stated allele is c.1457T>C p.Met486Thr. Not a gap.
- **G-lcat-001** (4:67583648:T:C): withdrawn (D-48, 2026-11-15; Claude under Jimmy's delegation): placed on chromosome 4 because paper 31684177 states transcript NM_012108.3, which is not an LCAT transcript; the paper's change is p.Ile202Thr in LCAT. Not a gap.

**Other points for the panel:**

- Blau candidates: the papers number NOD2 on NM_022162, so their protein numbers are 27 above the candidates' MANE numbers; placement is correct.
- LCAT: 17 of 26 candidates come only from papers ClinVar cites, and 18 only from reviews (mostly table rows of one systematic review, 34256778, with no case description).
- The dossier helpers' own notes (contradictions inside papers, likely duplicate people, unclear phase) are in `adjudication/o3_gaps_ext/helper_notes_2026-11-15.md`.

Evidence dossiers: 45 of 45 written; check_dossiers: 869 quotes, all verbatim (0 lenient-only), 0 problems.

## 6. Decisions (D-48, 2026-11-15) and review pages

Jimmy delegated the four open decisions ("For the 4 decisions, you can decide for me"). Claude decided:

1. **NOD2 legacy-transcript fallback adopted** for Blau (deviation D-48; registered figures reported beside it, §3).
2. **G-blau-008 (formerly G-blau-005) and G-lcat-001 withdrawn** (§4).
3. **No `isoform_sensitive` block for GAMT and PSTPIP1** kept (`analysis/extension/isoform_check_2026-11-15.md`).
4. **Review pages built.** Jimmy then approved publishing them ("Ok to publish", 2026-11-15). They are private Artifacts that Jimmy shares: O1X rater A https://claude.ai/artifact/V39NNdqsqSQJPitTggbwTQ, rater B https://claude.ai/artifact/RTVTM4wzLZZfMBPerz9Lk5, O2X triage https://claude.ai/artifact/QvPa2dccmoBsKSLwMdhP8R, O3X adjudicator A https://claude.ai/artifact/DmbNhhc3HedW5cMKZNvpA7. The page files embed paper passages, so they are not committed; `adjudication/README_extension_pages.md` rebuilds them.

Still open from the helpers: SURF patients with NOD2 variants and a healthy-control carrier (41357180); people with a diagnosis but no variant in several Blau and LCAT papers; a PDF-only paper whose genetic supplementary tables were unavailable (38180755); a duplicate-publication pair in GAMT (38020815, 39006040).
